translationRepairs: Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqqing, came from Huyang in Nanyang and was Emperor Guangwu's uncle by marriage.
Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqing, came from Huyang in Nanyang and was Emperor Guangwu's maternal uncle.
字靡卿 is Miqing (靡+卿), not Miqqing; 世祖之舅 means Shizu's maternal uncle, not uncle by marriage. The proposed idiomatic corrects both errors accurately.
Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqqing, was a man of Huyang in Nanyang; he was Shizu's maternal uncle.
Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqing, was a man of Huyang in Nanyang; he was Shizu's maternal uncle.
字靡卿 romanizes as Miqing; the literal's Miqqing is a spelling error, and the proposed fix is exact.
The county praised his beauty and pushed him to be one of the three elders.
The county praised his excellence and pushed him to be one of the three elders.
縣中稱美 praises Chong's excellence/virtue that led to being named 三老, not physical beauty; replacing beauty with excellence matches the Chinese.
Creditors who heard were all ashamed and vied to go repay; his sons followed the command and to the end refused to accept.
Debtors who heard were all ashamed and vied to go repay; his sons followed the command and to the end refused to accept.
After Chong ordered the loan contracts burned (假貸……焚削文契), 責家 who rush to 償之 are the debtors who owe repayment, not creditors; Creditors is inverted.
